strict_image_goal_protocol: Goal RGB is provided; target category, target identity, target pose and target masks are not policy inputs. RGB-D and odometry are a separate input track.

IEVE.observed_reset_path: update_after_reset initializes gt_goal_idx from episode object_category. reset calls get_goal_id on the target image and replaces gt_goal_idx only when a detection returns a category. The metadata category can therefore remain when that detection returns None.
IEVE.port_requirement: Resolve this fallback explicitly before a pure-image comparison. Do not inject metadata category silently; a category-assisted variant must be a separate input track. This observation is about the reviewed public implementation, not proof about every configuration or the published paper's scores.
other_requirements: Original controller uses velocity commands, not this benchmark's four discrete actions; preserve or disclose the controller and physical time budget.
Full perception, mapping, DISK/LightGlue and switch policy are required before calling a result an IEVE reproduction.

port_requirements: Integrate the complete goal/scene graph, segmentation, correspondence and planning chain.
Use a documented local VLM or a separately authorized service; no external paid API was called.
Keep target labels and poses in the evaluator, not the policy interface.

interpretation: The completed RGB ImageNav transfer runs and custom LightGlue-frontier runs are valid scoped baselines, not measurements of complete IEVE or UniGoal systems.
